statement: For an exact-class algebraic witness incidence pi:W->H, raw surjectivity of the Zariski tangent map at an unverified source point cannot certify branch coverage. The route must either verify local integrability/smoothness of pi at a suitable point and proper/component binding, or prove the actual image is closed/proper and top-dimensional/dominant directly.
load_bearing_boundaries: source-point smoothness or direct smoothness of pi
does_not_cover: higher Artin lifting outside the smooth incidence
